answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 69 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 9 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 69 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 660 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the atlas here is verification, the meadow of cost is what stops the farm, and the timber of the record keeps every claim checkable.
